cases.doc: `g` is already bound; bindings are immutable.
cases.name: AlreadyRegistered

cases.doc: The deposit address and the recipient are the same address.
cases.name: SameAddress

cases.doc: `g` holds nothing this router may move (no balance, no trustline, or no allowance left).

cases.doc: The expiration ledger is not after the current ledger.

event_v0.doc: `amount` moved from the deposit address to its recipient.
event_v0.name: Swept

udt_struct_v0.doc: What a deposit address is bound to.
udt_struct_v0.name: Deposit

fields.doc: The last ledger of the allowance granted at registration (inclusive).
fields.name: expiration_ledger

fields.doc: The smart account every sweep pays.
fields.name: recipient

event_v0.doc: `g` is now a deposit address for `recipient`.
event_v0.name: Registered

function_v0.doc: Moves everything this router may take from `g` to `g`'s recipient. Anyone may call it. Returns the amount.
function_v0.name: sweep

function_v0.doc: What `g` is bound to, if it is a deposit address here.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc: Binds `g` to `recipient` and, under the same authorization from `g`, approves this router for `g`'s whole\nbalance through `expiration_ledger` (at most `max_expiration_ledger()` when the transaction applies). Returns it.
function_v0.name: register

function_v0.doc: Pins the asset contract for the life of this router.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc: The latest ledger an allowance (and a binding) registered now can last through: the network's maximum entry\nTTL from the current ledger, ~180 days on testnet and mainnet today.
